description:
The Role: 

Generate’s Prototyping Lab builds the experimental systems that let us measure protein function at unprecedented scale. By combining synthetic biology, large DNA libraries, high-throughput assays, and machine learning, the team creates workflows that turn complex biological questions into rich, usable datasets. 

We’re looking for two Scientists with a strong record in experimental synthetic biology to develop pooled screens capable of testing hundreds of thousands of protein variants in parallel to identify protein binders and modulators. You’ll shape these experiments via DNA library design, pooled in vitro protein display, and NGS-based enrichment analysis. For one of the two roles, we are looking for a Scientist who additionally has experience in mammalian cell engineering and membrane protein studies. Experience in computational modeling or statistical analysis would help you connect experimental design to the quality and usefulness of the resulting data. 

You’ll work closely with Protein Sciences and Machine Learning teams to build screening approaches that deliver clear, quantitative insight into protein function. The role offers substantial scope to originate and advance new technologies, with close collaboration across a well-resourced biotech team.

Here's how you will contribute:

  • Build pooled screening workflows to achieve scalable protein binding and functional readouts, from assay setup through data interpretation.
  • Collaboratively establish reliable assay conditions, quantitative measures, and handoff plans that enable project teams to maximize platform utility.
  • Identify opportunities to test unconventional hypotheses, applying the strongest concepts for drug program acceleration and supporting IP filings.  
  • Synthesize findings into clear recommendations, and present them in presentations and in writing to colleagues across disciplines.
  • Use quantitative reasoning, modeling, and critical literature review to inform experimental choices. 

The Ideal Candidate will have:

  • PhD in synthetic or systems biology, bioengineering or a related field with 0-1 year of experience; alternatively, a bachelor’s or master’s degree with at least 6 years of highly relevant experience.
  • Hands-on experience designing and running pooled binding screens, ideally using both purified proteins and cell-based assays.
  • For one of the roles, we are seeking strong cell-culture skills, including experience engineering cell lines for screening applications using methods such as CRISPR, lentiviral transduction, or transposon-based integration; experience working with membrane proteins is also highly preferred.  
  • Experience designing and building pooled DNA libraries, and using next-generation sequencing to track enrichment in selection campaigns.
  • Familiarity with recombinant protein production, purification, and/or binding assays is an advantage.
  • Ability to interpret complex screening data and write scripts in Python or a similar language; familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools such as Cursor or other LLM-based platforms.
  • Applies quantitative reasoning and sound experimental judgment to assess data quality, troubleshoot assays, and guide next steps.

  • Brings intellectual curiosity to new technical challenges, shares expertise readily, and helps colleagues grow through collaboration and mentorship.

Who will love this job: 

  • Biologists who integrate computational insight with experimentation to tackle complex problems.

title: Product Manager, Platform
description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. ROLE OVERVIEW AI is only as good as the data underneath it. Schemas is the configuration layer where customers model their scientific data and processes. It's the customer-defined data model that makes Benchling different from a point solution, and the contract every other system (internal apps, integrations, AI agents) relies on when reading or writing to Benchling. Get it right, and AI inherits a solid foundation; get it wrong, every layer above inherits the problem. As Schemas PM, you own the primitives (schema types, computed fields, fieldsets, constraints, static properties, data versioning) that every other team at Benchling builds on top of. This is one of the highest-leverage, most technically interesting roles on the platform team, and one we're investing in now as AI features across Benchling increasingly depend on the quality of the underlying data model. RESPONSIBILITIES Set product direction for Schemas and ship toward it incrementally, balancing fast prototyping with the platform stability admins and developers depend on. Relentlessly track how customers use Schemas — where it delights, where it fails — and build sharp personas and job-to-be-done context for each user type (admins, scientists, computational teams, internal and external developers). Bring customer "why," not just feature requests, back to Engineering and Design; partner with them closely to ship new capabilities. Champion structured, well-modeled data as the foundation for AI value across Benchling, anticipating what schema consumers will need next. Partner with Customer Experience, Field, Sales, and Marketing to get customer signal into the roadmap early. Partner closely with other Platform and Apps PMs — schemas underpin nearly every other platform surface, so alignment on sequencing and shared abstractions matters as much as your own roadmap. QUALIFICATIONS Energized by platform work and systems thinking; comfortable building the right abstraction ahead of need. Has designed, owned, or significantly evolved a data-modeling, schema, or configuration system used by external developers or technical admins — not just consumed one as a feature. Becomes the go-to person for customers, field, and engineers — not a router to engineering. Deep, demonstrated discovery practice: has built personas and JTBD frameworks from scratch, not just used ones handed to them. Track record balancing long-term vision with incremental shipping. Strong communicator across technical and executive audiences; B2B SaaS or developer-platform background preferred. Genuine curiosity about the science behind the data. You don't need a science background, but you should want one by the end of your first quarter here. HOW WE WORK Flexible Hybrid Work: We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. #LI-EK1 Benchling welcomes everyone. We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage agnostic. We invest in seed to venture to growth-stage technology companies, across AI, bio + healthcare, consumer, enterprise, fintech, frontier, games, and companies building toward American dynamism. a16z has $100B+ under management across multiple funds.

We’ve invested in companies like Anduril, Airbnb, Coinbase, Cursor, Databricks, Deel, Figma, GitHub, Roblox, SpaceX, and Stripe. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world.

The Role 

As the Business Development Partner, Technology, on our GTM Technology Network at a16z, you will build and cultivate direct, high-trust relationships with technical and product leadership (VP/Head of Engineering, Head of AI, CPO/VP Product, etc) at leading digital native and growth technology organizations, including top infrastructure, consumer technology, SaaS, and other important technology sectors.

  • Build and cultivate strategic, positive relationships for the firm with a network of technology decision makers, understanding their business challenges and connecting them to portfolio companies and partners to help them solve these challenges 
  • Develop and continuously refine an approach to building access and trust with key technical leaders, aligned to portfolio company GTM priorities

  • Established executive relationships within the technology sector, with a strong ability to independently manage those relationships 
  • Proven ability to self-start, operate autonomously, manage multiple priorities, independently contribute, ability to deal with ambiguity, and execute consistently in a dynamic environment 
  • Low ego, high empathy, and the capacity to collaborate effectively with diverse teams
  • You are an analytical thinker, able to seek and understand data to build a strategy around and execute against

description:
POSITION SUMMARY:


Natera is currently seeking a licensed Medical Laboratory Scientist to analyze specimens and maintains equipment in good operating condition.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:


• Verify the proper specimen being analyzed and perform tests that need to be completed
• Proficient at analyzing clinical laboratory specimens following the standard methods and procedures in an efficient manner with little to no errors
• Responsible for maintaining updated understanding and knowledge of methods performed in the lab
• Provides general oversight of personnel and the daily operations in the lab.
• Meet expected performance metrics within role as applicable.
• Follows GLP (good laboratory practice): maintain clean and organized workspace
• Completes training and other deadlines on time.
• Provide guidance for new Clinical Laboratory Operator and/or Medical Laboratory Scientists.
• Train on specialized instructions for instruments/protocols (super users)
• Recognizes and escalates equipment malfunctions; troubleshoots common analytical and processing errors according to the laboratory’s standard operating procedure
• Recognizes, documents, and escalates protocol deviations in lab to lead/supervisor
• Assists with documentation for nonconformance reports.
• Participates in the updating of departmental standard operating procedures and database to accurately reflect the current practices.
• Conducts independent continuous improvement projects
• Ensures compliance with all regulatory agency requirements through proper documentation (example maintenance logs, bench worksheet)
• Performs quality control procedures to ensure accuracy of clinical data (if applicable)
• Maintains equipment and instruments in good operating condition (such as calibration and expiration date)
• Maintain inventory of material, supplies and equipment in the laboratory for performance of duties.
• Communicates with team and other departments on various platforms (including via e-mail)
• Provides feedback on day-to-day schedule and tasks to lead/supervisor; offers suggestions/ideas for improvement
• Assists teammates in completing daily tasks and facilitate workflow as needed
• Conducts himself/herself in a professional manner; acts as a role model/mentor to others
• Adheres to Departmental Expectations
• This role works with PHI on a regular basis both in paper and electronic form and have access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job
• Employee must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire.
• Must maintain a current status on Natera training requirements.
• Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • BS/BA degree in Medical Technology, Biological Sciences, or a related field
  • Current MT/MLS/CLS/MB certification preferable from ASCP, AMT, or AAB 


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:


• Excellent interpersonal, communication, computer, troubleshooting, and pipetting skills.
• Experience in Molecular Biology preferred.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Word processing and data management skills.
• Ability to work well in a group
• Ability to work independently, with minimal supervision

 

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT:


• Duties typically performed in BSL-1 to 2 laboratories with potentially hazardous material
• Standing or sitting for long periods of time may be necessary
• Duties may require working weekends and overtime
• Must be able to lift boxes or supplies up to 35lbs
• Duties require wearing safety goggles, gloves, and laboratory coat.
• Duties require exposure to cold air due to frequent accessing of refrigeration and/or freezer units.

 

Must be able to discern color visually [or be able to evaluate cellular morphology when applicable] and pass applicable screening assessment

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

title: Assistant Video Editor
description:
WHAT YOU'LL DO

Vox Media is looking for an Assistant Video Editor to join a growing post-production team within the branded content division for Vox and New York Magazine. This role is built for an editor early in their career who is sharp with turnkey and templated formats, comfortable owning quick-turn social cuts independently, and eager to grow into larger, more complex projects under supervision. You'll also work closely with the Post-Production Supervisor to set up and organize projects for external editors, making you a key connective piece between in-house editing and the freelance bench.

 

Editing and Craft

  • Edit turnkey and templated content such as cutdowns, recaps, and repeatable social formats for various platforms
  • Cut quick-turn social edits independently, following established templates and house style
  • Take on larger or more complex edits with guidance from the Post-Production Supervisor and Creative Directors, building toward independent ownership of bigger projects over time
  • Add basic music and sound design to elevate templated pieces
  • Apply light color and LUTs following house presets

Project Setup and Coordination

  • Partner with the Post-Production Supervisor to set up and organize projects for external/freelance editors such as bins, sequences, and file structure, following in-house SOPs
  • Create stringouts for Editors and Creative Directors per project
  • Prep and organize incoming footage, dailies, and assets ahead of handoff to external editors
  • Support project wrap-out and archiving, keeping files clean and organized across both in-house and external-editor projects

 

Workflow and Technical

  • Work in Adobe Premiere, including Team Projects and Productions, following house SOPs for project, bin, sequence, and track structure
  • Support turnovers to color and sound mix during finishing on larger projects
  • Work flexibly across a remote and hybrid workflow, including shipping/receiving drives and cloud sync as needed

 

Collaboration and Delivery

  • Share cuts via Frame.io and address internal notes accurately, flagging concerns proactively
  • Maintain clear communication with producers, the Post-Production Supervisor, and external editors
  • Learn from and support senior editors on shared projects, with room to grow into more senior editing responsibility over time

WHO YOU ARE

  • 2-3 years of experience editing in a digital, social, or branded content environment
  • Comfortable and fast with templated, repeatable edit formats, with a desire to grow into more complex, independent work
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Premiere; familiarity with team projects/Productions is a plus

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centered creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Role Overview

The Analytics Engineer role serves as a key member of the Measurement Enablement team, responsible for ensuring client healthcare marketing data is accurate, current, and ready for reporting and analysis. This role bridges the gap between Data Engineering, analytics teams, and client stakeholders by managing data ingestion processes, validating data quality, maintaining reporting-ready data structures, and resolving issues throughout the data lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate enjoys investigating data questions, identifying root causes of data discrepancies, improving data quality, and working across multiple teams to ensure reliable data powers business decisions. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—New York City, Boston, Chicago, San Francisco, Indianapolis, or Lambertville (NJ)—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs.

Primary Responsibilities 

Data Ingestion & Source Management 

  • Coordinate the onboarding of new client data sources and data feeds.  
  • Partner with Data Engineering to ensure successful ingestion of data into Databricks.  
  • Monitor data delivery schedules and ingestion processes.  
  • Maintain source documentation, field mappings, and data inventories.  
  • Work directly with internal teams and external partners to resolve source-related issues. 

Data Quality & Stewardship 

  • Monitor data freshness, completeness, and accuracy across client datasets.  
  • Perform ongoing quality assurance and reconciliation checks.  
  • Investigate missing, unexpected, or inconsistent data.  
  • Escalate, coordinate and resolve remediation efforts with the appropriate teams.  
  • Maintain documentation of data quality findings and resolutions.  
  • Support the development of automated data quality checks and monitoring processes. 

Data Modeling 

  • Develop and maintain client-specific standard, custom, and master tables and reporting views within Databricks based on a medallion architecture.  
  • Assist with transforming and standardizing data from multiple sources into reporting-ready structures. 
  • Solve problems and help build solutions related to the data model to meet evolving reporting and analysis needs. 
  • Document business rules, transformation logic, and metric definitions.  
  • Support maintenance of reusable reporting datasets and standardized data models. 

Stakeholder Support 

  • Act as the primary point of contact for routine data-related questions.  
  • Partner with Client Services, Media, Strategy, and Data teams to align on data outputs and expectations. 
  • Work with analysts and measurement leads to understand reporting requirements, translate into technical requirements, and provide database-modeled data for reporting.  
  • Communicate data issues, impacts, and resolutions to stakeholders.  
  • Assist with troubleshooting data discrepancies impacting reporting deliverables. 

Reporting Support 

  • Support Power BI developers and business analysts with data-related questions.  
  • Assist with report validation and troubleshooting.  
  • Help verify data displayed in dashboards aligns with source systems and business requirements.  
  • Provide support for semantic models and reporting datasets when needed. 

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL and Python skills, in a Databricks environment preferrable. 
  • Experience using ETL tools and data manipulation concepts (Funnel.io, DBT, or similar applications). 
  • Comfort partnering with Data Engineering on data sources, schemas, and refresh logic. 
  • Deep analytical and problem-solving skills related to data storage and structure for reporting.
  • Experience reviewing data logic, KPI definitions, and QA outputs. 
  • Basic BI (Tableau, Power BI) skills including data modeling, dashboard structure, calculated fields, usability, data storytelling. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Ability to translate complex business reporting requests into modeled data to support current and future analysis. 

Preferred / Bonus 

  • Pharma, HCP, or healthcare media analytics experience, including experience with media PLD (Physician Level Data).  
  • Digital media measurement expertise (media KPIs, attribution concepts, omnichannel analysis). 
  • Experience inheriting or stabilizing existing data warehouse schemas.

私たちは、「すべての患者さんに可能性を届ける」という共通の目的のもとで働いています。Avalere Healthは、すべての患者さんが必要な治療、支援、ケアを等しく受けられることを目指しています。Advisory、Medical、Marketingの各チームがそれぞれの専門性を生かして連携し、ヘルスケアが障壁とならず、誰一人取り残されない未来を築いています。
このミッションを実現するためには、社員一人ひとりが目的意識を持ち、患者さんの人生に具体的な変化を生み出せる環境が必要です。私たちは、多様なバックグラウンドやスキルを生かし、自分らしく働きながら、世界中の患者さんのために力を発揮できる文化づくりに取り組んでいます。

インクルーシブな文化は、私たちのすべての活動の中心にあります。Diverse Ability、Family、Gender、LGBTQ+、Mental Health、Race/Ethnicityの6つのEmployee Network Groupを通じて、社員が自分らしく働ける環境を支援しています。これらのグループは、定期的なミーティングや活動を通じて、多様性、公平性、インクルージョンを促進し、つながり、学び、交流する機会を提供しています。また、私たちはFertility Friendly認定企業として、不妊治療に関する方針、充実した育児休暇制度、柔軟な働き方を通じて、家族形成のあらゆる段階にある社員を支援しています。
日々のキャリア経験、数千に及ぶオンデマンド研修、定期的なキャリア対話、グローバルかつ部門横断的なキャリア機会を通じて、社員の継続的な成長を積極的に支援しています。

description:
WHO ARE WE

Parse Biosciences, a QIAGEN company, is a global life sciences company whose mission is to accelerate progress in human health and scientific research. Empowering researchers to perform single cell sequencing with unprecedented scale and ease, its pioneering approach has enabled groundbreaking discoveries in cancer treatment, tissue repair, stem cell therapy, kidney and liver disease, brain development, and the immune system.

With technology developed at The University of Washington, Parse has raised over $100 million in capital and is now used by over 4.000 customers across the world. Our growing portfolio of products includes Evercode Whole Transcriptome, Evercode TCR, BCR, Gene Capture, and Trailmaker, our data analysis solution.

Parse Biosciences is based in Seattle, Washington's vibrant South Lake Union district, where we recently opened a 34,000 square foot headquarters and state-of-the-art laboratory.

THE POSITION

As a Technical Sales (Account) Manager, you will be responsible for achieving sales objectives for our single cell RNA sequencing products through the development of new business and management of current customer accounts. You will be expected to create and execute a sales strategy across academic, biotech, and pharmaceutical accounts while working closely with Field Application Scientists and other Parse team members. Candidates should have strong technical skills, sales skills, the ability to develop and manage customer relationships, and a drive to overachieve. Gaining a deep understanding of the single cell market and Parse’s products will be critical to success. 

TERRITORY AND TRAVEL

You will ideally be based in Canada (mid to eastern), covering all of Canada. All types of accounts will be covered (e.g. Academic, Pharma, Biotech, etc.).

IN THIS POSITION, YOU WILL

  • Generate and manage both high volume and large complex sales
  • Ensure customers are satisfied and making rapid experimental progress
  • Develop, maintain, and grow repeat business while maintaining strong relationships
  • Prospect effectively to generate an immediate, medium, and long-term sales pipelines to ensure consistent quota obtainment
  • Negotiate and close deals while minimizing discounting
  • Effectively communicate technical advantages to customers
  • Develop a quarterly and yearly business plan that incorporates both strategic and tactical activities
  • Prioritize and qualify inbound leads
  • Provide management with insight on competition, market trends, and customer feedback
  • Manage your sales funnel with a high degree of accuracy
  • Leverage expertise of Field Application Scientists to support customers and drive sales
  • Leverage expertise of prospecting specialists to maximize customer meetings and drive new sales
  • Use CRM to manage and track deals
  • Continue to develop technical knowledge related to new, emerging, and related single cell research
  • Forecast projected sales in your territory
  • Display a high degree of professionalism both internally and externally

FOR THIS POSITION, WE LOOK FOR

  • Bachelors in biology/genomics or a related field. A Masters or PhD is a plus
  • Minimum of 1 year of field sales experience in NGS and/or genomics-related products or services, including both account management and new business development.
  • Previous molecular biology lab experience is preferred
  • Excellent communication skills - written and verbal
  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% of the time (locally, nationally, and internationally as needed)
  • A home office in or very near Montreal or Toronto, Canada.

COMPENSATION

  • Base salary + uncapped commission (commission paid quarterly)
  • 1st quarter commission guarantee for new hires
  • Salary is based on a number of factors and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience
  • Discretionary time off policy and Winter holiday break 
  • Monthly car allowance and internet and/cell phone stipend
  • No out-of-pocket (flight/hotel/rental car) travel expenses

JOB CONDITIONS

  • This position is home office based and will require a reliable internet connection and suitable workspace to fulfill job duties effectively. 
  • Regular communication and collaboration with team members will occur virtually through zoom meetings, instant messaging, and email. 
  • Travel requirements: This position include regular travel to visit potential and current clients, attend conferences, and meetings or training at the company headquarters in Seattle. Candidates should have the flexibility to accommodate travel requirements as needed.

description:
Présentation du poste : Au sein de l’équipe Data Analytics d'Artefact, vous rejoignez un pôle clé couvrant le dashboarding, l'analytics engineering, la mesure marketing et le low-code data science. Dans un environnement à forte croissance, vous intervenez auprès de grands comptes pour transformer leurs enjeux business grâce à une collecte, un traitement et une visualisation de données performants.

Ce qu’on attend de vous : En tant que profil Senior, vous garantissez l'excellence technique et la qualité de la valeur livrée sur vos projets analytiques. Vous jouez un rôle de conseiller de confiance auprès des clients, tout en mentorant des profils plus juniors et en intégrant les derniers usages d'IA Générative appliqués à l'analytics.

Vos missions :

  • Piloter la livraison de projets Analytics de bout en bout : du cadrage des cas d'usage avec les équipes métier jusqu'au déploiement de dashboards, pipelines et produits data décisionnels.
  • Concevoir et implémenter des architectures analytiques scalables en appliquant les pratiques modernes d'Analytics Engineering (modélisation de données, tests, qualité de code).
  • Exploiter les développements récents en GenAI pour maximiser la valeur délivrée à nos clients.
  • Extraire des insights stratégiques et les restituer de manière claire et actionnable pour accompagner la prise de décision des parties prenantes.
  • Agir en expert référent auprès des clients : construire une relation de confiance et apporter des recommandations sur les meilleures pratiques d'analyse de données.
  • Mentorer les Data Analysts juniors, partager les meilleures pratiques (ateliers, documentation) et participer à la création d'accélérateurs internes et à la veille technologique.

Profil recherché :

  • Expérience & Mindset : 3 ans ou plus d'expérience concrète dans un environnement data-driven, avec autonomie, rigueur et curiosité intellectuelle.
  • Domaines d'expertise (au moins 1) :
    • Dashboarding & Dataviz (Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Superset)
    • Analytics Engineering (dbt sur BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks)
    • Marketing Analytics & Mesure (CDP, MMM, attribution, Clean Rooms)
    • Low-Code / No-Code Data Science (Dataiku, Copilot Studio)
  • Socle Technique : Solide maîtrise de SQL et Python, bases en Git et principes d'ingénierie logicielle (versioning, tests), ainsi qu'une expérience sur les environnements Cloud (GCP, Azure, AWS).
  • Posture & Communication : Capacité avérée à faire le pont entre équipes techniques et métier, accompagnement des profils juniors et communication claire.

Process de recrutement :

  • HR Call : Échange initial sur votre parcours, vos motivations et l'adéquation culturelle.
  • Technical Interview : Évaluation approfondie de votre socle technique (SQL, Python, Cloud) et de vos expertises Analytics.
  • Business Interview : Mise en situation sur la résolution de cas d'usage business et la restitution analytique.
  • Fit Interview : Échange final de projection opérationnelle et de fit culturel.

Rémunération : Package : 53 000 € à 63 000 € brut annuel (fixe) + 5 000 € de variable, selon expérience et séniorité.

A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients. Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.

title: Implementation Manager - Bilingual
description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. ROLE OVERVIEW Benchling is building a world-class Professional Services team to drive implementations for our rapidly expanding customer base. Implementation Managers work with our customers, from small Biotech startups to the largest BioPharmas in the world to develop a deep understanding of their R&D Processes, and roll out solutions that transform how their research teams work together. To be successful in this role, you will leverage your scientific background, project management skills, and product expertise to drive successful implementations of the Benchling platform. You will work hand in hand with the research scientists at our customers, and teams throughout Benchling to implement our solutions, and ensure our customers are successful. Implementation Managers lead all aspects of customer rollouts from requirements analysis and solution design, to configurations, testing, training, and onboarding users onto the system. Fluent or native French or German, plus experience supporting French- or German-speaking customers. RESPONSIBILITIES Manage initial rollouts for new Benchling customers as well as expansion projects with new teams or for new processes at existing customers Own implementation success from project kickoff to go-live, leveraging strong project management skills, scientific expertise, and deep product knowledge. Build and execute detailed project plans, own project activities, work with other team members to execute on project deliverables to ensure on time, on budget, high quality deployments. Understand customers' scientific workflows and determine how Benchling can best be leveraged to meet their key business needs. Lead requirements and design workshops, perform data modeling & application configuration, develop test plans and guide UAT execution, train and onboard users. Act as a trusted advisor for customers, guiding them through the implementation ensuring they leverage and apply Benchling Best Practices. Understand and document customer pain points, advocate for them internally to influence product changes. Identify and work with sales on opportunities for account expansion post go-live. QUALIFICATIONS MS or Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Immunology, Bioinformatics, Biological Engineering or a related field. At least 2 years of experience in a lab or R&D setting, ideally in antibody discovery or strain engineering or process development. You must be able to empathize with scientists and quickly understand complicated scientific concepts. Software Implementation experience, preferably with a SaaS software company. Strong communication skills. You must be able to quickly and effectively connect with a range of stakeholders, including scientists, IT project leads, and executives. Self-starter with the ability to be successful in a startup environment. Curious, creative, and tenacious. You should be excited to collaborate with customers and other Benchling teammates as a thought partner. Ability to travel up to 25% based on customer and project needs. Fluent or native proficiency in French or German Experience using Benchling, especially if you’ve been a Benchling administrator, is preferred but not required. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday). #LI-Hybrid #BI-Hybrid Benchling welcomes everyone. We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

title: PLOS One Public Health and Epidemiology Associate Editor- 12 Month FTC
description:
*This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK and the following US states: FL, IL, MA, MD, NY, PA, TX, VA. 

This is a 12 month FTC

In the US, this is a union represented position as part of the Pacific Media Workers Guild, Local 39521 of the NewsGuild-Communication Workers of America.

 

Role Summary

PLOS is a nonprofit organization on a mission to drive open science forward with measurable, meaningful change in research publishing, policy, and practice. We believe in a better future where science is open to all, for all. The Associate Editor oversees the editorial process for manuscripts submitted to PLOS journals.  This role will require the use of prior research experience, critical evaluation skills, and internal guidelines to make nuanced and complex editorial decisions. The Associate Editor works with colleagues in their division and other teams to deliver developmental and promotional activities for PLOS journals.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a point of escalation for complex and nuanced editorial queries.
  • Support other teams at PLOS, members of the editorial board, and third-party editorial teams to ensure high standards of scientific rigor and editorial integrity are upheld.
  • Evaluate submissions and make decisions based on reviewers’ comments.
  • Participate in activities to develop editorial policy and improve the visibility and reputation of journals in the PLOS portfolio.
  • Handle publication ethics queries.
  • Build relationships with members of the academic community.
  • Demonstrate a positive, constructive attitude to change and a growth mindset.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Experience in a research environment, publishing, or other relevant industry.
  • Highly organized and efficient, with strong critical assessment, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and oral.
  • Able to work under tight deadlines whilst achieving a high standard of quality and accuracy.
  • Able to set priorities and work independently.

Qualifications

  • Postgraduate degree in a relevant subject area required. A PHD, MD or similiar level is preferred. 

Physical Requirements and Work Environment

  • Prolonged periods stationary at a desk and working on a computer
  • Some national and international travel may be required occasionally
  • Some flexibility to work across time zones

The base salary range we’ve established for these positions is $67,000 to $73,000. PLOS also offers a comprehensive benefits package summarized below. 

BENEFITS: 

 

  • 401k with employer match
  • Employee sponsored health, dental and vision insurance (Dental and Vision 100% employer paid)
  • Paid Vacation, 11 public holidays and sick leave
  • Parental leave
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off
  • Short term and long term disability insurance
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office 

 

About PLOS 

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

We’re committed to equal opportunity

We’re working to create a more equitable system of scientific knowledge and understanding. Removing barriers to inclusion and facilitating broad participation of voices is core to our success, inside and out. 

Beyond accepting distinct perspectives, we seek and support divergent backgrounds among our staff because we know differences strengthen our teams, our work, and our communities. We strongly encourage applicants of all identities to join us as we work towards a future where science is open to all, for all. 

Visit plos.org/careers to learn more.

 

 

To learn more about how PLOS protects your privacy, see our Employee Privacy Notice.

The Inside Sales Manager is a senior level commercial position responsible for strategically leading the Inside Sales Team. Working closely with field sales management colleagues, the Inside Sales Manager leading the Inside Sales Representatives, will develop and implement action plans to increase the customer base, maximize sales revenue and increase market share by demonstrating commitment to surpass our customers’ expectations. 

 

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Maintain and develop Inside Sales processes, lead generation, and quarterly project planning, to establish an approach for successful solution selling.

  • Develop and publish weekly/monthly performance dashboard reports for each Inside Sales Representative utilizing data captured through CRM module activity details and call metrics.

  • Prepare and present quarterly analysis to Senior Management on Inside Sales Team activities related to bookings, lead generation, meeting and quote opportunities.

  • Create monthly project summary to share with stakeholders, providing project details such as project overview, starts/end dates, number of sites to call, and setting appropriate metrics to evaluate results.

  • Influence internal and external stakeholders, such as members within Sales Administration Management, C-level, and Marketing, to help remove obstacles and support goal achievement of the Inside Sales Team.

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution required.

  • 2+ years of inside sales management experience.

title: Payments Pricing Lead
description: About Everfield Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem. Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing. Everfield Payments are an ambitious and innovative embedded payments business working inside a company that buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our intention is to transform the way Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) integrate payment acceptance into their solutions. With a small but rapidly growing team, we are focused on delivering exceptional, scalable payment solutions tailored to the needs of the European market. About the Role As Payments Pricing Lead you own pricing for Everfield Payments end-to-end: the strategy, the policy, the tooling behind it and the way our business units put it into practice. This is a build role. Most of our business units are new to selling payments. A large part of this job is enablement: getting their commercial teams and leadership comfortable with payments economics so they can sell profitably. You will work closely with Proposition, Sales/GTM, Finance and our development team, and we expect you to bring your own view rather than wait to be asked for one. You will be one person serving a growing number of business units, so using AI to scale yourself is part of the job rather than a nice extra. This is a hands-on role for a key individual contributor. What you will do: Work with relevant stakeholders on input costs, reconciliation and how margin lands in the P&L, and with Sales/GTM so market feedback reaches the relevant sales enablement tools and strategies Design and own Everfield's payments pricing strategy enabling Business Unit’s sales teams to win payments business at the right margin. Develop discount and incentive strategies and structures for payments and payments hardware Develop and implement a margin management process, including regular profitability monitoring, which can be delivered across regions and PortCo's Manage process of re-pricing and monitoring back-book customers Own the requirements for our enablement tooling and work with our development team to ship it. Run profitability monitoring across business units and markets, and lead the re-pricing of back-book merchants where margins are too low Develop pro-active strategies to re-price merchants as part of the growth strategy Support Business Units to win complex deals, RfP’s and negotiations Enable and coach business units to sell payments profitably. Most are new to payments, so expect to run training, build playbooks and templates, and develop local champions. Who We Are Looking For: Proven capability to operate effectively at all levels and gain the confidence of colleagues and senior management Deep, hands-on knowledge of payments economics: interchange, scheme fees, IC++ versus blended. You spot the opportunities in a cost overview and are up to date with pricing strategies of the competition AI native. You already use AI tools to be more efficient and enhance your contribution Significant experience in a commercial pricing role within a high transaction volume business, ideally in payments Able to explain payments economics clearly to people who do not know payments. Much of this role is teaching commercial teams who are new to the industry Self-directed. You will set the agenda for this function rather than receive it, and we expect proposals to come from you Desirable experience: Experience pricing across several European markets with different competitive dynamics Experience in a fast-paced start-up or scale-up environment Comfort with data tools (SQL, Tableau, Power BI or similar) What We Offer: Attractive salary package with performance-based bonus. Remote Flexibility (Can be based in the UK/Spain/Holland/Germany/Poland/France) A collaborative team culture based on respect, ownership, and trust. Benefit from access to international experts within the Everfield ecosystem — accelerate your personal and professional growth. Regular team events and company celebrations. We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision is made based on skills, qualifications and experiences. We look forward to receiving your application! Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Partner Enablement Manager
description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done. Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma. We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today. This role is preferred office-based to support in-person mentorship and collaboration across internal and partner teams. We’re also open to Benchling employees who are currently remote. ROLE OVERVIEW Benchling is looking for a Partner Enablement Manager to help our implementation partners deliver Benchling in pharmaceutical and life science accounts. You'll train partners in live and virtual sessions, help run partner certification, and observe and coach partners on real projects. You'll bring what you learn back to the CX Enablement team so we can improve our courses. When it works, partners are ready faster, customers go live with confidence no matter who implements, and fewer partner-caused issues reach Support and Professional Services. This role is a step into enablement for someone who already has experience with Benchling and enjoys teaching others (for example by walking customers through issues, writing knowledge articles, or onboarding new teammates.) You'll work with CX Enablement, Professional Services, Product, the Partners team, and with partner organizations directly. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. RESPONSIBILITIES Train partners directly through live and virtual sessions, such as onboarding cohorts, workshops, and product deep dives, for both subcontracted and direct partner delivery teams Help administer partner certification, including tracking progress and supporting partners through it Gather feedback from partners on where their teams struggle, and work through it with the rest of the CX Enablement team to decide what to improve or build Build partner-specific coursework where it’s needed, and work with the CX Enablement team to bring it into certification pathways Support Professional Services in running subcontracted and direct partner programs by tracking partner readiness and flagging risks early Observe partners on real work, give feedback, and coach them directly on improvements Help prepare partners for new product releases, working with Product and CX Enablement so partners are ready alongside internal teams Report on defined partner readiness measures, such as time to certification and partner-caused support issues, to the enablement team and Professional Services leadership QUALIFICATIONS Required Experience teaching Benchling to others, such as through customer calls, escalations, knowledge articles, or onboarding new teammates Hands-on experience supporting or implementing Benchling, with a deep working knowledge of the platform Comfortable presenting to technical and scientific audiences, or eager to build this skill with coaching Experience giving direct, constructive feedback, such as through case reviews, shadowing, or mentoring Experience turning recurring questions or feedback into clear written content, such as help articles or runbooks Experience working across teams like Product, Engineering, or Professional Services to resolve issues BS or M.Sc. in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Genetics, or similar life science field Nice to have Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) practice: capturing and improving knowledge articles as part of solving issues Experience working with outside partners, consultants, or implementation teams A scientific background, through a life science degree or work in scientific settings Experience using data to show whether training worked Benchling welcomes everyone. We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

title: Cloud Architect (m/w/d)
description: Wir sind Royal Runtimes. Wir bauen AI-Systeme, bevor andere darüber Folien machen. Wir sind ein kleines AI-Studio in Hamburg. Wir beraten Unternehmen zu AI und bauen dabei genau die Dinge, die wir selbst jeden Tag benutzen. Manche davon werden zu eigenen Produkten, die wir mit Partnern als Joint Ventures launchen. Andere bauen wir nur für uns, weil wir sie brauchen. Für ihre Architektur suchen wir jemanden, der Google Cloud besser kennt als wir beide zusammen. Mit wem du arbeitest Henning hat bei Tchibo als Head of AI Engineering & Platform die AI-Transformation vorangetrieben. Mit GPT-1 hat er schon unlustige Witze-Bots gebaut, als noch niemand Sprachmodelle kannte. Als studierter Statistiker hat er sogar manchmal Ahnung, wovon er redet. Erik hat Consulting einmal komplett durchgespielt, zuletzt als Business Unit Manager Data & AI bei Reply. Im früheren Leben war er Data Scientist, Python-Enthusiast, ML-Evangelist, Contributor bei Apache Spark und MLflow, blahblahblah. Du gehörst zu unseren ersten Einstellungen und arbeitest vom ersten Tag an direkt mit uns beiden. Wir werden kontinuierlich wachsen. Du lernst viel von uns, und wir wollen auch von dir lernen: die neue Harness, die du am Wochenende getestet hast, den neuen Skill, der unsere CI/CD 100x besser macht. Was du bei uns machst Du sorgst dafür, dass wir unsere AI-PaaS auf Hunderte Enterprise-Kunden skalieren und betreiben können. Du steuerst Agents. Die Guidelines und die Governance, nach denen sie Terraform, Pipelines und Code bauen, entwickelst du selbst. So skalieren wir unsere Software Factory. Wir treffen die technischen Grundsatzentscheidungen der Plattform gemeinsam, unter deiner Führung. Du arbeitest am Produkt. In Beratungsprojekte holen wir dich für Strategiefragen oder wenn ein Team nicht weiterkommt. Was du mitbringst Mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung mit Google Cloud. Du hast dort Plattformen entworfen, gebaut und in Produktion betrieben. Du bist die Person, die gefragt wird, wenn bei Google Cloud sonst niemand weiterweiß. Du könntest jede Ressource selbst in Terraform schreiben. Du lässt das Agenten machen und bist das Mastermind hinter deiner Agent Fleet. AI ist dein Beruf und dein Hobby. Wenn im AI-Umfeld etwas Neues erscheint, hast du es ausprobiert, bevor andere davon gelesen haben. Egal ob Modell, Tool, Framework oder Hardware. Du baust lieber, als darüber zu reden. Du willst jeden Tag dazulernen und kannst mit Feedback umgehen. Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Was dich erwartet Keine Limits beim Werkzeug. Tokens, Hardware, Software: Du bekommst, was du für sehr gute Arbeit brauchst. Wir sehen das als Arbeitsmittel und diskutieren nicht über Budgets. Ein Venture, das du mit aufbaust. Die PaaS ist ein eigenes Produkt neben unserem Kundengeschäft. Du bist früh dabei und übernimmst dort eine entscheidende Rolle. Kunden mit Anspruch. Konzerne und große Mittelständler, die wirklich umbauen wollen, Private-Equity-Portfolios und Startups. Was wir in diesen Projekten über Builder Companies lernen, fließt in die Plattform. Büro in der HafenCity. Wir arbeiten jeden Tag zusammen vor Ort, mit Blick über die ganze Stadt. Das passt nicht, wenn du lieber allein im Homeoffice sitzt, als mit uns zusammen zu bauen. du klare Prozesse und ein fertiges Ticket-Board erwartest. du Terraform lieber selbst tippst, als es Agenten schreiben zu lassen. du AI für einen Hype hältst. So geht's weiter 30 Minuten Call Ein halber Tag bei uns in der HafenCity: schnacken, essen, zusammen etwas bauen Danach entscheiden wir. Ja oder nein, schnell. title: Solution Marketing Manager | Luma
description:
Our Why At Dotmatics 

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company,  we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics 

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.  Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. 

What do we need

Scientists are solving some of the hardest problems in the world. Your job is to make sure they find the tools that help them do it. 

As a Solution Marketing Manager at Dotmatics, you'll work at the center of science and communication, deeply understanding how researchers in your application area think, what they're trying to accomplish, and what gets in their way. You'll translate that understanding into stories, campaigns, and content that connect scientists with the right solutions at the right moment. 

From a product perspective, Luma and ELN are your primary vehicles. Both require messaging that works at the enterprise level and resonates with specific scientific audiences. Dotmatics also has a broad portfolio of specialized products, each with their own dedicated marketers. Your job is not to own those products, but to connect them into compelling solution narratives when they're relevant to your audience and use case. 

We're looking for someone who is genuinely curious about how scientists work, who loves the challenge of making complex ideas land, and who finds real satisfaction in building something from the ground up. If that sounds like you, we'd love to talk. 

In this role you will get to: 

  • Own the positioning, messaging, and content development for your scientific application area: personas, use cases, value propositions, differentiation, and collateral.
  • Develop strategic campaign briefs that translate positioning into actionable guidance for demand generation and integrated marketing.
  • Build and maintain sales enablement materials that help the Dotmatics commercial team have better conversations, including pitch frameworks, solution narratives, objection handling, and competitive context.
  • Partner with the wider marketing team to deliver the message to the market.
  • Engage directly with internal subject matter experts and customers to gather insights and shape strategy.
  • Act as the voice of your scientific audience across marketing and sales, influencing decisions and building alignment across senior stakeholders. 

We are looking for people who have 5+ years in a role where science and communication intersect: marketing, field applications, science communications, or similar, ideally in life sciences or research software. 

  • Scientific grounding to have credible conversations with researchers. A degree in a relevant discipline can be a real advantage here, and relevant hands-on experience is equally welcome.
  • A track record of taking something complicated and making it click for an audience who didn't have time to become an expert.
  • You've had the chance to build something from scratch before, and you want to do it again.
  • You're comfortable working across functions and influencing without direct authority. 

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information. 

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

title: Compensation Analyst, People Services
description:
People Services Compensation Analyst  

The Opportunity 

 

Uniting the expertise and capabilities of Ashfield and Huntsworth Health, Inizio has just been launched to become THE strategic partner for health and life sciences companies. Unparalleled in scale and expertise, we connect a full suite of Advisory, Medical, Marketing/Communications, Patient and Stakeholder Engagement, and Biotech services to reimagine clients' business challenges into opportunities.  

 

We are a team of 12,000 experts working together in 35 countries to create something extraordinary. We exist to solve health challenges and develop transformational ideas that positively impact human lives. Working at Inizio offers an opportunity to work for a game-changing company built with one goal. That is to redefine health and life sciences by empowering our people to inspire new possibilities that advance health and build brighter futures. 

 

The Role 

 

As a Compensation Analyst, you will be responsible for supporting the day-to-day administration and delivery of compensation programs and processes across the business. Reporting to the Service Delivery Senior Manager – TComp and Leaves of Absence, you will play a key role in ensuring compensation transactions, annual compensation cycles, reporting, and system processes are completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with established policies and controls. Working closely with the Total Rewards team and other key stakeholders, you will help maintain compensation data integrity, provide operational support to HR colleagues and managers, and identify opportunities to improve processes and the overall service experience. 

 

Here’s What You’ll Be Doing 

 

Annual Compensation Cycle Operations 

  • Support the administration and execution of annual merit and bonus cycles, ensuring activities are completed accurately and within established timelines. 
  • Assist with compensation cycle preparation, including eligibility reviews, data validation, Workday configuration, and testing. 
  • Provide operational guidance and support to HR colleagues and people managers throughout compensation planning cycles. 
  • Monitor compensation submissions, approval workflows, and completion of required activities. 
  • Validate final compensation outcomes and coordinate payroll outputs and reconciliation to ensure accurate processing. 
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies, escalating complex issues to the appropriate stakeholders. 

Job and Market Data Operations 

  • Support compensation benchmarking activities, including salary survey participation, data collection, and submissions. 
  • Maintain compensation benchmarking databases and support job matching and market data reviews. 
  • Assist with the maintenance of salary ranges, job grades, and compensation structures. 
  • Support the accuracy and consistency of job architecture and related compensation data. 
  • Provide data and analysis to support compensation reviews and recommendations developed by the Total Rewards team. 

Compensation Data and Reporting 

  • Prepare and maintain standard compensation reports, dashboards, and audit reports. 
  • Analyze compensation data to identify discrepancies, trends, and opportunities for improvement. 
  • Support the preparation of pay equity and pay-gap datasets, ensuring data accuracy and completeness. 
  • Respond to ad hoc compensation data requests from HR, Finance, and Total Rewards stakeholders. 
  • Review and validate compensation requests to ensure alignment with established policies, guidelines, and approval requirements.  
  • Support standard offer compensation validation and preparation of compensation-related letters and documentation. 

Compensation Technology and Process Controls 

  • Support the administration of compensation processes within Workday, including configuration, testing, troubleshooting, and data validation. 
  • Partner with HR Technology and Total Rewards to support system enhancements, process changes, and annual cycle readiness. 
  • Support internal audits and compliance activities by maintaining accurate records, documentation, and audit evidence. 

Compensation Service Management 

  • Serve as a point of contact for compensation-related inquiries from employees, managers, HR colleagues, and People Services. 
  • Manage compensation-related cases and requests through established service management processes, ensuring timely and accurate resolution. 
  • Develop and maintain knowledge articles, process guides, and standard responses to support self-service and consistent guidance. 
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, accuracy, and the employee and manager experience. 
  • Partner with HR, Payroll, and People Services to ensure compensation changes are accurately recorded and processed in Workday.  

 

 

What Do You Bring To The Role? 

 

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
  • Previous experience in compensation administration, HR operations, Total Rewards, or a related HR function, ideally within a global or shared services environment. 
  • Experience supporting annual compensation cycles, including merit increases, bonus administration, and compensation data validation. 
  • Working knowledge of compensation principles, salary structures, job grading, and market benchmarking processes. 
  • Experience using Workday HRIS, particularly compensation-related processes and transactions, is highly desirable. 
  • Strong analytical skills with advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data manipulation, reconciliation, and reporting. 
  • Excellent attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy and confidentiality. 
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify discrepancies, investigate issues, and recommend practical solutions. 
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and support stakeholders in different locations. 
  • Experience working within a service delivery environment, including case management, SLAs, and process documentation, is desirable. 
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with global teams. 
  • A commitment to continuous improvement, process standardization, and delivering high-quality customer service. 
  • Professional compensation certification, such as Certified Compensation Professional (CCP), is desirable but not required. 

Our Pledge 

At Inizio, we value inclusivity, recognize the power of diversity and inspire the next generation of change-makers. We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe in creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity, equity and inclusion. We strive to recruit from a diverse slate of candidates and foster an environment that provides the right conditions for long-term success. title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a field-based scientific expert responsible for engaging healthcare providers, generating insights, and supporting Medical Affairs priorities across Natera’s oncology portfolio, including our personalized minimal residual disease (MRD) testing. This role focuses on building strong scientific relationships, delivering clear and accurate education, and bringing back actionable insights from the field. You will own your territory, make decisions independently, and deliver clear clinical data to providers to help them make better-informed decisions.

Territory: North Texas, Arkansas, Oklahoma

 

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Establish and maintain scientific relationships with healthcare providers and key opinion leaders (KOLs) within a defined territory.

  • Deliver accurate, balanced, and clinically relevant education on Natera’s oncology products and data.

  • Deliver on territory plans aligned to Medical Affairs priorities.

  • Identify and communicate field insights, including treatment trends, unmet needs, and competitive dynamics.

  • Respond to unsolicited medical inquiries in a timely, compliant, and scientifically rigorous manner.

  • Support execution of Medical Affairs initiatives including advisory boards and medical education programs.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of disease states, clinical data, and the evolving oncology landscape.

  • Collaborate directly with Sales, Marketing, and R&D to move work forward without relying on rigid processes.

  • Maintain medical independence and strict compliance, always keeping the patient at the center of your work.

  • Support and coordinate clinical trial and research initiatives at academic institutions and study sites.

  • Meet all metrics as assigned and complete appropriate documentation and tracking of field visits, insights, and research opportunities.

  • Travel extensively (over 60%) as required.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Advanced healthcare/scientific degree preferred (Ph.D., Pharm.D, M.D., D.N.P.). Master’s degree required.

  • Diagnostic, IVD, or device experience preferred.

  • Must live within the assigned territory.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Clear communicator and independent thinker.

  • Ability to work remotely while maintaining a strong teamwork ethic.

  • Make evidence-based decisions quickly and operate with urgency to get meaningful products to clinicians without compromising quality.

  • Use strategic thinking to contribute to product, departmental, and organizational plans and goals.

  • Adapt quickly when priorities shift and solve problems rather than waiting for structure.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to read, interpret, and convey complex scientific information.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Remote position requiring frequent sitting, standing, walking, and daily computer use.

  • Extensive travel required.

  • Requires the ability to communicate over the telephone and read printed material.

  • Duties may require working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends).

  • Complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training, and security training within the first 30 days of hire.

  • Reasonable accommodations available for individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. title: Founding GTM Associate
description: About Us Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity. Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance. We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, Taktile, Vertice, and OakNorth. Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures. Position Overview As a Founding GTM Associate, you’ll sit at the centre of Condukt’s commercial engine, generating new pipeline across financial services and working hand in hand with our Account Executives to turn it into revenue. You’ll build opportunities from the ground up: reaching high-growth fintechs and financial institutions with well-researched outreach, qualifying inbound interest quickly, and running first discovery conversations. Your work doesn’t end at the first meeting. You’ll stay on the deal with our Account Executives, help build the customer relationship and, as you grow, lead smaller deals end to end alongside an AE. As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move with urgency, and are excited to help build both a market-leading product and a repeatable enterprise sales motion. You’ll work closely with our AI Deployment Strategists, Product, Engineering, and Leadership to shape how we sell, who we sell to, and how we win. If you’re at the start of your commercial career, energised by meeting new people, and keen to take on more responsibility fast, this role is for you. What you’ll do: Own early-stage pipeline creation with fintechs and financial institutions that match our ideal customer profile Research and map target accounts, identifying the right C-level Risk & Compliance, Operations, and Product leaders to engage Help build and run our outbound motion, with sharp, well-researched messaging across email, LinkedIn, phone and events. Test creative formats beyond the usual sequences, and turn what works into a repeatable playbook Respond fast to inbound interest and qualify every lead on fit, urgency and decision-makers Lead discovery calls, support AEs on live deals and, as you grow, lead smaller deals end to end Bring what you hear from the market back to Product and Leadership, helping shape who we sell to and spot new market opportunities Pick up whatever the business needs next: priorities will shift as we scale, and you’ll help shape where we go What you bring: 1-3 years in a client-facing or target-carrying role, with a proven record of booking net-new meetings Genuine energy for meeting people, and the confidence to pick up the phone, walk into a room of strangers and start the conversation Resilience in the face of rejection, and the drive to keep going for the wins Ability to learn fast, handle ambiguity and change course when priorities shift Hands-on attitude, with a focus on outcomes rather than titles Intellectual curiosity about the compliance space Fluency with AI and data tools to work faster and smarter Strong organisation across follow-ups, sequences and your CRM Low-ego, collaborative approach and openness to feedback Genuine interest in fintech and how financial institutions onboard customers and manage risk Excellent written and spoken English The right to work in the UK Bonus: Sales experience preferred, but not required for the role Background in fintech, banking, payments, or lending ecosystems Second language proficiency (German, French, and Dutch, especially valued) Our offer: Tackle meaningful problems with real-world impact Competitive salary and equity package Flat hierarchy with direct access to the founders Hybrid, 3 days a week in our London office Top-of-the-line equipment Private health insurance, plus sick and compassionate leave as needed If you have any questions, please reach out to Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
